lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: {town} squats on its canals like a toad on a stone. The {empire}'s banners hang over every gate.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: There are soldiers on the bridges. More than any market town needs.

lines.speaker: gravemaw
lines.text: That's the Hunter-Captain's standard over the north gate. He's ahead of us.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: In the press of the crowd a small hand slips into {mc}'s coat, and out again.

lines.speaker: needles
lines.text: That sword of yours sings louder than mine. Half the street can hear it.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: The thief is gone. Above the plaza, a horn sounds.

lines.speaker: captain
lines.text: Close the gates. The bearer is in the town.
